A [[Thisspiasian/Legends|Thisspiasian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], '''Oppo Rancisis's sister''' was the [[Blood Monarch/Legends|Blood Monarch]] of [[Thisspias/Legends|Thisspias]] around [[186 BBY/Legends|186 BBY]]. She was killed by revolutionaries in that year within her own [[Thisspias alcazar|alcazar]] on [[Ratamesh]]. Her brother, [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]], was the heir but he declined the throne in order to become a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]].
